title: DNA Polymerase Function
text: DNA polymerase is the enzyme that synthesises new DNA strands during replication. It adds nucleotides one at a time to a growing chain.

title: Directionality Constraint
text: DNA polymerase can only add new nucleotides to the free 3'-OH (hydroxyl) group of the growing strand. This means synthesis always proceeds from the 5' end toward the 3' end of the new strand.

title: Remember the Rule
text: Think of it as 'building onto the 3' end' - new nucleotides are always added at the 3' end, so the strand grows in the 5' to 3' direction.
